entities.name: Sevinne
entities.description: A human chronarch from Dominaria trained in temporal magic at the Tolarian Academy who roams the world seeking adventure.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: The academy where Sevinne trained in temporal magic.

events.summary: Sevinne, restless with book learning, leaves the Tolarian Academy to roam the world after gaining his wizard's mantle.
events.quote: he grew restless with book learning and left to roam the world
